scope: Project-run onboarding, editorial and UI regression checks. No outside users, new Lighthouse score, human listening or every-frame certification.

developer_ui.scope: Local browser interactions and 390px layout; graph response mocked and clipboard API stubbed. Documented copied code separately executed by clean consumer.

static_mobile.scope: Production build navigation: no irrelevant API requests/subscriptions and no horizontal overflow. This is not a Lighthouse or physical-phone measurement.

pitch.template: User-supplied black/blue/amber editorial image, rebuilt as an editable PPTX

pitch.artwork: Six selected newly generated conceptual artworks; actual AI Passport screenshot separately labelled. No customer or deployment evidence fabricated.

remaining_gaps: One configured RPC supplies unseen-history completeness; no independent state/non-omission proof.
No unaided outside integration or established ecosystem moat.
Small separate root-update demo; no production migration or automatic policy rotation.
Mobile performance scores are historical simulated lab results, not physical devices or field INP.

hosted_ui.scope: Owned live domain. Actual MP4 playback/seeking and deck/package downloads; overview/SDK interactions and 390px layout. The SDK UI fixture and clipboard remain stubbed in its interaction case; real npm/RPC checks are separate receipts.

npm_production_audit.scope: npm audit --omit=dev on this checkout; not an audit of arbitrary applications.
